earnedRewardReceiptRejectionTests.scope: Recorded public receipts; rejection of failed or substituted receipts, wrong token, missing transfer, smoke epoch and tampered allocation.

automaticTestnetLifecycle.scope: Real local SQLite/EVM; GPU, verifier and GitHub are test doubles.

productionHttp.scope: Real production Next server and temporary SQLite; GitHub release responses are test doubles.

publicationHandoff.scope: Disposable local git fixtures; reviewed files only, repeat application, remote advance rejection and runtime-path exclusion.

liveProof.scope: Verifies the allocation, canonical funding/claim receipts and token transfer. Does not independently attest to physical GPU execution.

limitations: Physical GPU evidence is the operator-observed RTX 4090 validation record. No new GPU execution was performed by this closeout.
No mainnet transaction, public load test or independent audit.
GitHub publication and VPS deployment are not implied by preparing this source.
